details.effects: New deterministic physical model reconciles only nominated surviving sources, with no stock or mastery. Paid direct body-scale observation gives approximate world-distance dimensions, resolution0.02/uncertainty0.01, visible continuity and whole endpoints0..1. This is not calibrated SI metrology or a strength measurement. Changed source quantities/processing invalidate geometry. Only entire measured pieces can be placed; original identities leave inventory and remain conserved in the actual arrangement. Two paid stages preserve process and remaining labor. Actual obstruction or insufficient energy pauses before further charge. Cancel/death ends work while placed matter persists in containment, never free recovery or remote return. Recovery preserves source identity, quantity and condition; no damage/strength restoration. This kinematic loose-wrap model does not implement tension, friction, calibrated forces, knots, durability, functional tool or utility. No passive work, upkeep charge, pleasure or satisfaction. No historical skill inheritance.
